claims.content: To allow a customer to regain access to their account by resetting a forgotten password.

goal.raw_text: To allow a customer to regain access to their account by resetting a forgotten password.

claims.content: The customer clicks the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page.

trigger.raw_text: The customer clicks the 'Forgot Password' link on the login page.

claims.content: The user clicks the 'Forgot Password' link.
The system displays a page asking for the email address associated with the account.
The user enters their email address and submits the form.
The system validates that the email address exists in the database.
The system generates a unique, one-time password reset token and sends an email to the user containing a link with this token.
The user receives the email and clicks the password reset link.
The system validates the token and displays a form for the user to enter a new password.
The user enters and confirms a new password.
The system updates the user's account with the new password hash and invalidates the reset token.
The system displays a confirmation message and redirects the user to the login page.
